summary.intent: Drive Wave 4 and Wave 5 of the CipherBox v2 rewrite to completion: resolve PR reviews across a queue of draft PRs, rebase and merge them in dependency order, clean up tracker/worktree hygiene, plan and launch Wave 5 and Wave 6, and rotate/rename staging deployment secrets and env vars including a live SSH host-key MITM fix.
summary.outcome: Wave 4 (6 PRs) and Wave 5 (7 PRs) fully merged with all review findings resolved; tracker hygiene fixed (milestones, parenting, dependency edges); staging env vars/secrets renamed and rotated including a new 1Password-held SSH deploy key; a real host-key verification gap in deploy workflows was found and partially fixed (ed25519 pin) before a security-review agent caught that the pin would fail closed due to Go's SSH algorithm negotiation order, which was then fixed at the sshd_config level; Wave 6 plan (8 PRs) written but not yet launched.

repo: CodeRabbit posts a 'clean' verdict only by editing its status comment ('No actionable comments were generated'), never a review body — polling only review bodies causes an infinite hang on a passing PR

macroscope's check-run 'completed' state includes 'skipped' (e.g. when credits are exhausted with 'Credit balance exhausted' in output.title), so completion must not be conflated with actual review coverage
macroscope can post findings up to ~9 minutes after its check-runs show completed — querying threads right after completion can miss late findings
A `success` conclusion on a macroscope check-run does NOT mean zero threads were posted

Two PRs adding an identical field/enum variant to the same file at different offsets can merge with git reporting NO conflict, producing silent duplicate declarations (TS2300/E0004-style) that neither PR's CI can catch — always run `git merge-file`/build the actual combined tree before trusting `mergeable: CLEAN`
GitHub REST `.parent` field on issues always returns null — must use `.parent_issue_url`; any orphan sweep built on REST `.parent` produces false negatives
GitHub environments-variables/secrets list API paginates at 10 by default without indicating truncation — must pass per_page=100 or check .total_count
GitHub Actions secrets are write-only with no read endpoint at any scope — rotation requires generating and setting new values, not copying old ones
`gh api` does not accept `--arg` — using it silently breaks jq filters and returns empty results that read as 'no findings'
Squash-merge repos mean a merged branch tip is never an ancestor of main — reachability checks for 'is this landed' must use PR state, not `git merge-base --is-ancestor`

Seam trait implementations that exist only as test fakes (no production `impl Trait for RealType`) compile clean and pass all tests while being completely non-functional in production — check for production callers, not just green tests, when auditing 'is X delivered'
zsh (used by the Bash tool) does not word-split unquoted variables in for-loops, unlike bash — `for x in $VAR` with multi-value $VAR silently iterates once as one string
Piping a command through `tail`/`tee` masks its real exit code (`$?` reflects the pipe's last command) — always capture exit codes unpiped

Go's ssh.ClientConfig default HostKeyAlgorithms order prefers RSA/ECDSA before Ed25519, so pinning an Ed25519 fingerprint fails closed unless the server is configured to offer only Ed25519 (or `HostKeyAlgorithms` is set client-side)
`easyssh-proxy` (used by appleboy ssh-action/scp-action) falls back to `ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey()` (accept any key, always) when the `fingerprint` input is empty — not TOFU, full MITM exposure
Postgres only applies `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` on an empty/uninitialized data volume — rotating it against a live volume just breaks auth until a paired `ALTER USER`

v2 has no Redis or TEE-worker dependency (removed from `apps/api`), but `docker-compose.staging.yml` still declared both services referencing env vars that `.env.staging` never emitted, so they silently ran with empty passwords

code.finding: reseal_verdict exhaustive match over ResealError — adding a new ResealError variant elsewhere (e.g. TooManyCommittedGrants) is a compile-time break here since there's no catch-all arm, which is what caught wave 5's semantic merge conflict
WriteSubtreeResolver trait doc says production wiring is not landed and tests fake it — confirmed true with zero production callers on main, leading to filing issue #1108
gateway-read scenario against staging fails closed with an explicit error if LOAD_TEST_GATEWAY_URL is unset — not a silent bug as initially assumed
hand-rolled if/echo/exit guard for SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT could be replaced by the repo's existing `: "${VAR:?msg}"` idiom used elsewhere in the same file

workflow: Never apply a code-review bot's suggested diff literally — treat it as a symptom report; multiple times this session the literal fix would have been wrong (deriving Debug on a Zeroizing secret type, destroying a persisted refresh credential via clear_session, a helper that ignores its parameters and returns a constant)
When driving unattended overnight PR review cycles, explicitly set and communicate the boundary of not merging anything, since merges to protected branches are hard to reverse
Before evaluating whether an umbrella/tracking issue is 'complete', parent all orphaned children first — an issue can look 0/0 done only because a real child was never attached to the rollup

Give parallel agents unique scratchpad paths, ports, and browser instances — shared scratchpad file names, shared Puppeteer browser sessions, and shared dev server ports between concurrent agents caused clobbering and context loss

Verify the committed tree (`git show HEAD:<path>`, `git status --porcelain` empty before AND after gates), not just the working tree — an agent fixed a bug in the working tree, ran green gates against it, then pushed the unamended pre-fix commit, causing a CI failure

When rotating a credential that must live in 1Password per convention, generate it via `op item create --ssh-generate-key` and `op read` so the private key never touches disk, rather than generating locally and shredding after upload

Diagnosing infra connectivity issues under intermittent local network flakiness can lead to false diagnoses (fail2ban, stopped sshd) — check server-side logs (journalctl) for the actual source IP reaching the box before assuming server-side blocking
Confirm host key changes out-of-band (e.g. via cloud provider's browser console) rather than trusting a network-path SSH scan when a host key mismatch is detected

friction: Persistent intermittent local network flakiness throughout the session, refusing GitHub API calls and SSH connections, twice leading to misdiagnosis of server-side causes (fail2ban, stopped sshd) before being correctly identified as local
Six distinct 'false all-clear' defects discovered in the custom recycle-both.sh review cycle script across two waves, all failing in the same direction (reporting coverage/success when none occurred)
Fleet concurrency limit (20 subagents) caused the /simplify, /security-review, /crypto-privacy-review subagents to be unavailable for one PR, requiring manual passes instead
zsh shell quirks (word-splitting, pipe exit-code masking) caused several false-negative verification results mid-session
macroscope reviewer ran out of credits mid-wave, leaving 6 of 7 wave-5 PRs with only one bot reviewer instead of two
Web E2E Smoke Result required CI check is flaky (smoke.spec.ts:43 sign-out test) and blocked at least one engine-only PR unrelated to web code

GitHub secrets/variables API silently truncates list responses at 10 without pagination hints, causing a false 'variable does not exist' conclusion that propagated into two planning documents before being corrected
open_items: Remove old CD SSH key from VPS authorized_keys after first green staging deploy confirms the new 1Password-held key works via the Actions ssh-action
Run a staging deploy to push rotated secrets (JWT_SECRET, TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET) into live .env.staging
Publish the IPFS gateway (Caddy route + forward_auth + IPFS_GATEWAY_TOKEN secret) — IPFS_GATEWAY_URL is set but nothing serves it yet
Wave 6 execution not yet started — plan written (8 PRs) but no ship agents launched
desktop-e2e.yml still installs/starts Redis and sets REDIS_HOST/REDIS_PORT despite v2 having no Redis dependency — inert but not cleaned up
macroscope credits need topping up before further waves with crypto/data-integrity-sensitive PRs

Top-level docs (ARCHITECTURE.md, GETTING-STARTED.md, CONFIGURATION.md, CAPACITY.md) still contain stale v1 redis/TEE references, deliberately left as-is since they're being rewritten separately per AGENTS.md

Residual SSH host-key fix PR (#1114) fingerprint corrected at sshd_config level (ed25519-only) after security-review caught that Go's algorithm negotiation order would have selected RSA and failed the pin closed — needs final CI verification and merge
#1107 and #1108 (grantee-arm rotation resolver, WriteSubtreeResolver) filed but not scheduled until wave 7 due to net/rotation.rs contention with wave 6's #1108(PR2)
